svg.title: Rash: ideas in motion
svg.desc: A twenty second capability explainer: design vectors and type, choreograph keyframes and masks, direct Three.js geometry with animated cameras, then publish SVG, GIF, PNG, HTML, PDF stills or browser supported MP4 and JavaScript embeds. Rust and WebAssembly workers, RuVector search, local resources, Claude skills and optional Ruffle SWF playback. Reduced motion shows the first chapter. This editorial header uses Rash geometry; it is not an editor project.

g.text: From the first point to the final frame.
Templates · web + social sizes · touch editing
Every keyframe. Every curve. Your timing.
One composition. Many ways to share.
SVG · GIF · PNG · HTML · PDF raster stills · MP4¹
